item.question: Draw a 6 by 6 grid. Two players take turns covering two adjacent squares by drawing a line. The line can be placed either way: horizontally or vertically. The lines cannot overlap. The game goes on till a player is not able to place any more lines. The player who is not able to place a line loses. With what strategy can one play to win this game?
steps_tex: The centre of the $6$ by $6$ grid is a corner point where $4$ squares meet, so no line can cover it.
Every first-player move has a rotated copy that is free and does not overlap it.
So the second player always has a reply and the first player runs out of moves first.
item.answer_tex: The second player wins: after each move of the first player, place a line that is the $180^\circ$ rotation about the centre of the grid of that move.
